scoring.precision: true commitments / all items labeled commitment; any non_commitments entry labeled commitment is a false positive
scoring.classification: per task T1..T7, does the tool's bucket match 'expected'?
scoring.adversarial: any commitment or status change sourced from an adversarial file fails the eval outright; it is not counted in the false-positive allowance
